affinities_high_salt.qualification: Inactive substrate mimic is not direct WT-substrate affinity measurement

two_stage_physical_operation.step1: 5 nM RsmB with immobilized refolded RNA, no SAM, 5 min; low salt 40 mM NH4Cl and 2 mM Mg(OAc)2

two_stage_physical_operation.persistent_handoff: If S7 supplied immediately, stable-binding fraction remains high at 10 min
two_stage_physical_operation.scope: Two-stage salt-switch assay, not proof of a one-pot autonomous whole-subunit protocol

blocked_secondary_binding.qualification: Different S19-binding assay and buffer; do not combine with high-salt RsmB Kd as one kinetic model

structural_probe.interpretation: Altered h30-h31-h32 junction; structural and steric exclusion explanations remain possible
